title: Global sections acyclicity of direct images of K-injective complexes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\varphi:A\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ a ring map. Let $I$ be any K-injective unbounded complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. With module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], module-valued global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], and derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], the right-derived unit for $G=\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}\circ\Gamma(Y,-)$ is invertible at $f_*I$: $Q(G(f_*I))\to RG(Q(f_*I))$ is an isomorphism in $D(A)$. No flatness, quasi-coherence or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 20.28.2 (Tag 0D5T) and Section 20.28 (Tag 079V); point-valued global sections construction

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-direct-image-global-sections-kinjective-acyclic] to f and I. The unit of RΓ(Y,-) is invertible at f_*I. Choose the standard derived category for Γ(Y,O_Y)-modules as the intermediate category; no K-injectivity of f_*I is assumed.

For additive F and exact G, RF followed by RG with its composite unit is a right derived functor of F followed by G. At an object where the F unit is invertible the composite unit is invertible, since the G unit is invertible everywhere. The right-derived universal property gives an invertible descent comparison; its unit equation transfers invertibility to the standard unit of R(F followed by G). Apply this to F=Γ(Y,-) and exact restriction of scalars G=Res_φ, valid for every ring map, including noninjective φ and zero rings.

proof_origin.note: Second reading M2: reused the existing direct-image global-sections acyclicity theorem, followed by exact restriction of scalars; no new sorry.

theorem isIso_globalSections_restrictScalars_unit_on_directImage_kInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (φ : A ⟶ Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    IsIso ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.hom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
        (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)))
